decisions.reason: Own page signals ongoing commitment; option kept open as market uncertainty remains high and keeping costs are low.
As a replacement for an existing Bricklet, it has established demand and low uncertainty, so the option is likely exercised.
Software option has low marginal cost and high IoT growth potential, so it is worth keeping open.
Only mentioned without a dedicated page suggests weak market traction, making its option value unlikely to justify further investment.
CO2 sensor benefits from rising ventilation demand and the own page shows commitment, so the option remains valuable.
Touch panel accessory supports the ecosystem but is more niche, so it has a moderate probability of being dropped while still kept open.
